description:
Hi, I'm Tabrez, a backend developer from Tajikistan. I build products with Python and FastAPI: Telegram bots (aiogram), CRM systems, and web platforms for real clients. I also teach programming and Arduino, so I'm good at explaining things and keeping a team moving.

Why join: I ship fast. I can take an idea to a working backend, API, and bot within the first day, so the team always has something real to demo.
